fullContentHtml:
AIIMS NORCET 11th Stage-II Admit Card 2026 – Full Details

All India Institute of Medical Science AIIMS has released the Stage-II Admit Card for the Nursing Officer Common Eligibility Test 2026 (NORCET-11th) on its official website. This recruitment was released for 2218 posts. Applications for AIIMS NORCET 11th Recruitment 2026 were accepted from 24 July 2026 to 13 August 2026. The Stage – II examination is going to conducted on 30 September 2026. Candidates who had appeared for this exam can download their AIIMS NORCET 11th Stage-II Admit Card 2026 from the link given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 24 July 2026
  • Last Date : 13 August 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : August 2026
  • Stage-I Exam Date : 12 September 2026
  • Exam City Details : 03 September 2026
  • Admit Card : 09 September 2026
  • Result : 18 September 2026
  • Stage-II Exam Date : 30 September 2026
  • Stage-II Admit Card : 26 September 2026

Application Fee

  • General, OBC : Rs. 3000/-
  • SC, ST, EWS : Rs. 2400/-
  • PH Candidates : Rs. 00/-

How to Check Result

  1. Click on the direct official result link provided below.
  2. Enter your Roll Number / Registration Number and Date of Birth.
  3. Submit the form to view your scorecard on screen.
  4. Download and print a copy of the result for future reference.

AIIMS NORCET 11th Stage-II Admit Card 2026 is the official result announcement. Candidates can check their scorecard and merit status via the direct link above.
